B = data('*.indices.docs.count', filter=filter('plugin', 'elasticsearch') and (not filter('aaggregation', ' * OR aggregation: total', match_missing=True))).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A*100/B).publish(label='C')
